description: Na₄Mn₂P₂O₇F₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form distorted NaO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 71°. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.42 Å. There are two shorter (2.38 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and four F atoms. Both Na-O bond lengths are 2.54 Å. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and two longer (2.36 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are two shorter (2.32 Å) and two longer (2.81 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.52 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six MnO₂F₄ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-43°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.46 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form MnO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-43°. Both Mn-O bond lengths are 2.18 Å. There are two shorter (1.88 Å) and two longer (1.92 Å) Mn-F bond lengths. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form MnO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₂F₄ octahedra and corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-71°. There are two shorter (1.98 Å) and two longer (2.24 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. Both Mn-F bond lengths are 1.90 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₂F₄ octahedra, corners with three MnO₂F₄ octahedra, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-70°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.64 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent P atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₃Mn tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one Mn atom.
